estilo: Gibby: 3D estilizado tipo película animada, con la paleta de Abasto (turquesa menta, verde oscuro y lima). Todas son objetos recortados para que sobresalgan de las tarjetas. El texto del estilo está en scripts/ilustraciones/generar.mjs.

imagenes.uso: Acceso: la composición 3D sobre el fondo menta
imagenes.tema: A cheerful young delivery rider in a turquoise-mint jacket and cap with dark green details, waist-up, smiling and holding a smartphone that shows one big green chat bubble with a white check mark; two or three cardboard boxes and a paper grocery bag stacked behind him. Floating in the air with nothing under it, big and filling most of the frame.

A big cute rounded white smartphone floating at a slight angle, its screen showing a large green chat bubble with a white shield and check mark inside; a few small lime and mint sparkles and two tiny chat bubbles around it. Floating in the air with nothing under it, big and filling most of the frame. Absolutely no floor, no ground plane, no table, no shadow under the objects and no reflection: only the objects on the flat background.

A giant glossy dark green map pin with a lime ring standing on a tiny round floating island of a neighborhood: rounded mint and white houses, little round trees, a small corner store with a striped awning and a tiny mint delivery scooter on a curvy street. Floating in the air with nothing under it, big and filling most of the frame.
